name: Whole Branzino — Brown Stew Reduction, Coconut-Thyme Rice & Pickled Vegetables
alt: Whole Branzino with brown stew reduction, coconut-thyme rice and pickled vegetables: a whole crisp-skinned branzino on a long white plate, served with a mound of coconut-thyme rice, dark braised onions and peppers in brown stew sauce, a charred lemon half, and a tangle of pickled carrot, cucumber and red onion, on a dark wooden table.
